summary.root_cause_text: The orders database is read-only ('attempt to write a readonly database'). This is an infrastructure or storage problem, and no available tool can change it.
recommended: Have a human or the platform team check why the DB is read-only: file or volume permissions, a full disk, or a remount as read-only. Restore write access.
After that, restart the worker so the queued order (order 13) is processed.
Run check_data_integrity and reprocess_orders for any unpaid orders.
Confirm the ledger sync recovers and run repair_ledger if rows are mismatched.
